task: C12 measured cell-state controllability and regeneration
status: candidate quantitative marker-control result; goal not complete
scope: Primary 2025/26 literature on experimentally measured cell-state transitions and regenerative inputs; no wet-lab activity, medical recommendations, external messages, or publication.

claims.claim: After limbal stem-cell depletion with the niche preserved, corneal epithelial cells can regenerate an LSC-like state with lineage-traced long-term tissue maintenance and repeated injury repair.
claims.limit: This natural regeneration result is separate from cytokine rescue arms. GEO has one pooled single-cell library per timepoint, so the deposited trajectory is descriptive and does not estimate animal-level transition-rate uncertainty.

claims.claim: IGF1 and CCL2 rescue day-25 K15-GFP MFI after clodronate depletion; the combination contains half the individual dose of each factor.
claims.source: Dimri-Wagh et al. 2026, Fig. 5 and source-data workbook MOESM11, Figure 5, Fig. 5p
claims.limit: n=4 per group; marker MFI, not lineage-resolved long-term function. Clodronate reduces macrophages by about 77% at day 1; macrophage abundance during CCL2 rescue is not measured.

claims.claim: The half-dose IGF1+CCL2 group has normalized mean MFI recovery 1.027; full-dose single-agent means imply an independent-action Bliss ceiling of 0.932. Capping observed restoration at 1 still leaves a 0.0677 normalized-gap surplus. The half-dose CXCL16+CXCL10 pair is 0.331 versus its corresponding ceiling 0.347.
assumptions: single-agent responses are nondecreasing with dose
normalized MFI deficit recovery is a valid bounded effect scale
Bliss independent action is the comparison null
claims.limit: Candidate supra-independent marker interaction only; dose-response monotonicity and the bounded effect scale are not validated, and no formal synergy or stem-state claim follows.

claims.claim: The available in-vivo rescue data do not identify whether CCL2 acts directly on epithelial cells, by recruiting residual/new myeloid cells, or through another niche-mediated route.
claims.status: mechanistic limitation derived from intervention design
claims.source: Fig. 5 rescue protocol; approximately 77% depletion at D1; discussion states CCL2 may recruit additional monocytic cells
claims.limit: This is not the main advance and is not treated as a novel biological discovery.

claims.claim: Whether the IGF1+CCL2 cytokine regimen converts lineage-traced corneal cells into a durable functional LSC pool remains unknown.
claims.source: No rescue-arm day-40 molecular fate, long-term lineage maintenance, or repeat-injury result located in the primary paper
claims.limit: Do not infer functional recovery from day-25 K15-GFP MFI.

claims.claim: The primary paper's human data show marker support in pre-existing human limbal stem-cell cultures under high-calcium conditions; they do not test mature human corneal epithelial-cell conversion.
claims.source: Dimri-Wagh et al. 2026, Fig. 6 and methods
claims.limit: Nature transfer to mature human cells is unvalidated.

claims.claim: A 2026 hepatocyte-transplantation paper offers an alternative stage-gated mechanism involving Afp/PPARγ, neutrophil TNF/TNFR1/AP-1, OSM, and TGF-β-associated migration/zonation.
claims.limit: Underlying data are available on author request rather than public accession; article acknowledges missing AFP-Cre state-lineage proof. No contact was made.

next_decisive_gate: Run a dose-matched half-dose factorial in lineage-traced donor corneal cells; measure macrophage recruitment and local cytokines through D25; test a myeloid-specific CCL2/CCR2 recruitment block while preserving epithelial receptor capacity; assess donor-origin state at D40 and durable function/repeat injury through 6 months. The marker-only Bliss null predicts a half-dose pair score <= 0.9323 if the assumptions hold; the current point mean is 1.027.
